glosses: to partake in a jamboree, to have a wingding in the beer hall after the tasks of the day have been finished

examples.text: Das Kommersieren auf den Bierdörfern war früher weit mehr im Schwange als neuerdings die Exbummel.
examples.translation: Jamborees at the beer halls were earlier much more fashionable than lately excursions are.
examples.english: Jamborees at the beer halls were earlier much more fashionable than lately excursions are.
